Prescription Electronics Face Lift report Thread starter Thread starter frisco Start date Start date Sep 15, 2003 Sep 15, 2003 #1 frisco Formerly greeny Joined Jun 21, 2002 Messages 801 i have borrowed for a couple of days a friend's fuzz face clone, the FACE LIFT from prescription electronics. This one is the germanium one cause (you can order them in either germanium or silicon). The pedal comes with 2 switches one for fuzz and the other with octave fuzz ala octavia. you can blend both options or play them alone - i'm not a fuzz fan at all but i can say that when i rolled the volume of my guitar off the sound got clean. The hi gain setting gets you the Hendrix vibe thang ala "are you experience" i had used the pedal with the fuzz at a very low setting ( 7 to 8 o'clock) and with volume all the way up and boosts your signal nicely for leads. it adds meat to your sound. tha octavia sound nice for kick solos too. i have a Vibrolux reverb amp and i always thought that Fender amps where not fuzz friendly but this pedal has make me change my mind about it. cheers   Sep 16, 2003 #2 Shakkal New member Joined Apr 6, 2003 Messages 99 :eek   You must log in or register to reply here.
